title: Sunday · the window, still
logline: Heceta Frame & Matting's window from the sidewalk, eight years after Wood filled it with empty frames: some of them are still there, with the town in them. The owner never changed it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the frame shop's window from the sidewalk on 101: a dozen frames still, some empty, some now holding what customers brought — a boat, a diploma, a child's drawing — the road reflected across all of them.

image.prompt: a frame shop's front window from a sidewalk holding a dozen frames of which some are still empty and some now hold a photo of a boat, a diploma and a child's drawing, the road reflected across the glass, no words
image.notes: dw_2000-04-25's window, eight years on. 'People will bring their own.'

panels.name: Window

panels.composition: Tier 2: one empty frame among them, framing the reflection of a rusted small car parked across the road.
props: an empty frame framing the Datsun

image.prompt: an empty picture frame in a shop window framing the reflection of a rusted small car parked across the street, no words

panels.name: Empty

panels.composition: Tier 3: the shop's sign above, HECETA FRAME & MATTING, all letters present, the paint fading. Held.

image.prompt: a fading painted shop sign above a window with all its letters present, no words
image.notes: Letter after: HECETA FRAME & MATTING. All letters; one goes by 2014.
